firmware.releaseNotes: Owner-requested forward verification target for a device-initiated 3.3.36-to-3.3.37 OTA with the original-signed App 1.0.86. The MCU Check Update and Update Now entry must initiate this test; a phone-page update or direct J-Link installation is not an equivalent observation. This version adds no claimed MCU behavior fix and preserves the 3.3.36 product logic, companion protocol, BLE identity and V2 transport. Explicit device consent, no open recording, sufficient battery or charging, package integrity and post-reboot version plus full-image identity remain mandatory. Normal GCC full/recovery candidate; channel publication and an exact-base delta remain explicit operator actions.
